exam_scheme.note: DSSSB conducts recruitment for Special Educators under the One-Tier Technical / Teaching (I-T-T) examination scheme comprising a single 2-hour CBT paper of 200 MCQs (200 marks). Section A evaluates general aptitude (100 marks) and Section B tests domain knowledge in Special Education, Child Development, Learning Disabilities, IEP planning, and pedagogy (100 marks). Section B requires minimum qualifying marks of 40% (UR/EWS), 35% (OBC Delhi), or 30% (SC/ST/PH), with final merit decided on total marks across both sections.

Section A: Test of English Language & Comprehension

financial_package.note: Special education teachers in Delhi are placed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix: Primary Special Educators commence at Pay Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400) and TGT Special Education Teachers commence at Pay Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900), drawing standard Class 'X' metro allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 02/2023 & Addendum dt 27-05-2024 — Pay Scale for Special Education Cadre (Level 6 ₹35,400 / Level 7 ₹44,900)
financial_package.estimate_note: Spans entry Special Educator Primary at Level 6 basic ₹35,400 (gross ~₹72,240, in-hand ~₹66,600) to TGT Special Education Teacher at Level 7 basic ₹44,900 (gross ~₹90,100, in-hand ~₹83,000) with 58% DA, 30% Delhi HRA, ₹3,600 + DA on TA, less 10% NPS and medical scheme deductions.
official_perks: Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS) / MCD cashless hospital medical coverage
Resource Room and Special Needs Allowance / specialized pedagogy allowance for inclusive classrooms
Summer Vacation (approx. 50 days) and Winter Break (approx. 10 days) with full salary entitlement
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child plus hostel subsidy
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly government matching contribution
Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) accredited Continuing Rehabilitation Education (CRE) workshop sponsorships

competition_benchmarks.note: DSSSB Special Educator recruitments require specialized Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) qualifications, yielding high candidate selectivity. In the CBT for Special Education Teacher in DoE (Post Code 20/22), 2,793 candidates appeared for 364 vacancies with 767 shortlisted for e-dossier, verified directly from official DSSSB marks notices.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 8 for TGT Special Ed (calculated: 2,793 appeared in CBT ÷ 364 vacancies)
